**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (stacked on #566; it must merge after #566, which was reviewed clean at 8a11b1ec).

Reviewed the one commit beyond #566's head (18802064: move_model.rs, stock_follow.rs, locate.rs doc, tests, decision record).

**What looks good**
- One rule for every turn: `MoveModel::new` re-fits through `stock_follow::keep_square` whenever `turns(prev.rot, next.rot)` is true (move_model.rs:75-79, 123-125). The stock keeps its own axis-aligned orientation, so a 30 degree turn no longer tilts it; the allowances are read in the stock's frame.
- A move that only slides the part keeps the old rigid carry, and a copied-from-model or off-axis stock still turns rigidly; `keep_square` returns `Ok(None)` for those (stock_follow.rs:78-80).
- Undo is exact: `StockMove` snapshots the previous shape, mesh and place, and `invert` writes them back (move_model.rs:~215-235). The new `move_model_stock` test checks shape, place and facets through undo/redo.
- No unwrap/expect/panic added; non-finite or empty bounds and a stock that no longer wraps the part are refused by name (stock_follow.rs:82-87, 98-101).
- Decision record is present with the dropped alternative explained; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #571`; no snapshot PNGs, no Cargo/build.rs/scripts/.github changes in the PR.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, trial merge clean, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 105 passed |
| move_model_stock | 4 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| fixture_locate / fixture_locate_stock | 11 / 3 passed |
| setup_align, plane_align, top_stock, setup_stock_source, stock_stamp, wcs_align | 9, 9, 4, 6, 4, 5 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

The ui crate was not re-run: this commit touches no ui code (the ui locate tests were covered in the #566 review).

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Fixtures: the refit grows the stock to wrap the part's turned bounding box, and a plain Model-page `MoveModel` (unlike the locate) does no stock-versus-fixture interpenetration check. A turn can therefore enlarge the block into a vise. This is no worse than before (the old rigid tilt had no check either), but a follow-up issue to run the same check on any turn would close the "never sinks into a fixture" gap. There is no test with a fixture present in `move_model_stock`.
2. Tilted (non-Z) turns refit a larger, still axis-aligned block; the rule is "stays axis-aligned", not "follows Z rotation", and the decision record states this and why.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: baa8f5fbd6f473172c9346ba794749452610c5d0 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge - but only after #566 (this PR is stacked on it and contains its commits).**

Full re-review of the new head `baa8f5fb` (merge of main plus the two UI commits `7338fbd4` and `fde19af4`).

**What looks good**
- Merges cleanly with current `origin/main` (main is already an ancestor, no conflicts). The merge kept main's fixture / locate / pick / fixture-mesh code: nothing under `fixture_*`, `pick/`, `locate*` was dropped in the diff against main (only the PR's own #566/#571 additions show).
- #571: `MoveModel::new` now refits a square box/cylinder stock with `stock_follow::keep_square`, per-side allowances read in the stock's own frame; translation-only and off-axis/copied stocks keep the rigid follow. Undo/redo are exact (`move_model_stock`), `apply`/`invert` stay pure writes. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests, no unchecked index math (`stock_follow.rs` uses finite checks and array `from_fn`).
- The two UI commits are correct and scoped to the locate draft: `fde19af4` keeps the mates after Apply so Offset/Turn can be edited (one more undo step), `7338fbd4` adds `locate_pick::sweep` after the dock so a draft whose form was not drawn is dropped. Both are pinned in `locate_tests` (`leaving_the_page_drops_a_located_draft`, `the_fixtures_page_locates_*`, `a_refused_draft_says_why_instead_of_offering_apply`).
- No snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG, build.rs, `.github`, script or dependency changes. Decision records are per-PR files. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #571`.

**Local results (merged with main, own target dir)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| app `commands_undo` | 32 passed |
| app `fixture_locate` | 11 passed |
| app `fixture_locate_stock` | 3 passed |
| app `mcp_setup` | 5 passed |
| app `move_model_stock` | 4 passed |
| ui `--lib -- locate fixture setup` (CWD crates/ui) | 67 passed |
| clippy `-D warnings`: camcraft-app (lib + the 5 suites above), camcraft-ui all targets | clean |

Not clean on main itself (not this PR; it does not touch the file): `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets` fails to compile `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs:83`:
```
error[E0063]: missing field `hand` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`
```

**Requested before merge**
None for this PR.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. The UI commits are #566's review findings and belong on #566's branch; they ride along here only because this PR stacks on it. They do **not** fix #673: `sweep` runs after the dock, #673 is the same-frame release before the dock. That is the open #704 (stacked on #566 as well), so no overlap with this PR.
2. `crates/app/src/commands/setup_align.rs` is 387 lines (under the cap); `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is far over 400 and grew by the `locate_form_drawn` field (flag only).
3. The #566 diff is large; merge #566 first, then this one will shrink to the #571 commit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
